subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Strengthen
solution:
The correct answer is: **Debilitate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Strengthen"** means to make something stronger or more powerful. (मजबूत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Regular exercise can help to **strengthen **your muscles.
 
 
 
• **"Debilitate"** refers to making someone or something weak or feeble. (कमजोर करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The disease can **debilitate **even the healthiest individuals.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Strengthen'** is **'Debilitate'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Strain** (तनाव): To exert to the utmost; to injure by overexertion.

 
 
• **Example:** The heavy lifting could **strain **your back.
 
 
 
• **Fortify** (मजबूत बनाना): To make strong and secure.
 
 
• **Example: **The soldiers worked to **fortify **the walls of the fortress.
 
 
 
• **Ascend** (चढ़ना): To move upward.
 
 
• **Example:** They watched the balloon **ascend **into the sky.
